title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-2u0i: unused imports compute_mic and DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE in fragmentation test
description:
`rust/lichen-schc/tests/fragmentation.rs:8` imports `compute_mic` and `DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE` from `lichen_schc::fragment` but neither is used anywhere in this test file.

`compute_mic` is only used in `fragmentation_vectors.rs`, and `DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE` is not used in any test in this file (the tests use `DEFAULT_RECEIVER_LIMIT`).

Fix: remove `compute_mic` and `DEFAULT_WINDOW_SIZE` from the import on line 8.
